reasons.text: The label photo is shared with another claim (same photo hash), so the claim must go to a person for duplicate review under the program's duplicate rules.
The label photo is legible and shows model 98527, which is a recalled model, so the model is confirmed.
The purchase was at ALDI, a listed retailer, dated 2018-01-20, inside the 2016-01-01 to 2019-12-31 sale window; no receipt is required for this claim.
The destruction photo shows the power cord cut through, as the remedy requires, and it is not a repeat of the label photo.
The $40.00 refund is under the $100.00 person-review threshold; the flag, not the amount, is what sends this claim to review.
